verdict.rationale: Workers documents Smart Placement, which moves a Worker closer to its data to optimize end-to-end latency. That is the story's core capability, provided by the product itself. The evidence is two short marketing-level lines, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how placement is automatically determined (traffic analysis, enablement/config), explicit confirmation it needs no manual region selection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the latency gains.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
